extracted.text: In 2024, the VN-Index jumped 12.11% (from 1,129.93 points at the beginning of the year to 1,266.78 points at the end of the year) but the HNX-Index skidded 1.56% (from 231.04 points to 227.43 points). Daily trading value averaged 21,098 billion VND, 20.02% higher than a year earlier. The market capitalization of HOSE, HNX and UPCOM reached about 7,200 trillion VND, up 20% from the end of 2023 and equivalent to about 70% of GDP. 2024 also witnessed a boom in new underlying securities accounts, with more than 2 million new domestic individual accounts opened, bringing the total number of accounts to 9.30 million, equal to more than 9.17% of Vietnam's population.
